title: Docling upgrade and retained mapper controls
question: How does the installed Docling 2.148.0 family affect the incumbent PDF path?
method: Run seven matched Standard controls and replay exact A/B/C payloads and application mapping under both pins. Inspect one archived formula with the installed target.
